title: Echoes of Adventure: Runix Matrix
description: An "easy" way to make teleports by drawing formulas with chalk
body: ## [WARNING] This mod is currently in beta and is not considered stable. It is not recommended to include it in production servers or modpacks until a stable release is available. This version is provided for testing and preview purposes if you're interested in following its development. Please note that future updates may introduce breaking changes and could require creating a new world. --- **Echoes of Adventure: Runix Matrix** is a magic-themed portal mod focused on creating teleportation formulas using chalk-drawn magical patterns and rune manipulation. Players can draw portal formulas directly in the world using regular Chalk. These formulas create magical teleportation structures that range from simple portals to highly advanced rune-enhanced networks. The mod also introduces magical crafting formulas drawn on the ground. Instead of using traditional crafting tables, players create symbolic patterns using Chalk to craft special magical components. **Runic Chalks** are crafted through dedicated formula patterns and are later used to draw runes inside special portal nodes that are part of portal formulas. **Mana Stones** act as the primary magical fuel required for teleportation and portal activation. Basic portals come with standard parameters, but they can be heavily modified using runes. Different rune combinations influence portal behavior, magical effects, stability, efficiency, risks, and environmental interactions. ### Planned Features Checklist - [+] Ability to draw portal formulas. - [-] Ability to draw crafting formulas (patterns). - [-] Ability to craft Runic Chalks using magical formulas. - [-] Ability to draw runes inside special portal nodes. - [-] Ability to modify portals using runes. - [-] Portal modification with unique runes. - [-] 29 ready-to-use runes (*3 tiers). - [-] 29 Runic Chalk items. - [+] Mana Stone item. - [+] Chalk item. - [-] Guide Book item. - [-] Server config settings for Admin Chalk, allowing players to use admin portals. - [-] Datapack configuration support. --- ### Environmental Rune Influence - [-] Context-sensitive rune parameters. - [-] Biome-based rune parameter influence. - [-] Dimension-based rune parameter influence. --- ### Portal Risks & Debuff Effects - [-] Poison effects. - [-] Blindness effects. - [-] Weakness effects. - [-] Knockback effects. - [-] Burning effects. - [-] Direct damage effects. - [-] Portal explosions. - [-] Lightning strikes. - [-] Mob summoning events. --- ### Core Gameplay 1. Draw a magical formula using Chalk. 2. Activate the portal structure. 3. Craft Runic Chalks through magical crafting formulas. 4. Draw runes inside portal nodes. 5. Fuel teleportation using Mana Stones. 6. Modify and stabilize the portal. 7. Unlock stronger and more dangerous teleportation systems. # Bugs & Suggestions Found a bug? Something feels off? Or just want to suggest a feature? Report issues or share ideas on the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/fXze8HDK6c) for faster support and communication.
